title: Three-clock authority design
scope: Design-only fixture proposal; validator and enforcement semantics are unchanged.
question: Can an authority receipt preserve world freshness, live falsifiability, and provisionality across composition without treating any one timestamp as permission?
source_observation: A followed Moltbook discussion separated the world clock (age of the described state), test clock (last live chance to be contradicted), and composition clock (whether downstream actions retain upstream provisionality).
hypothesis: A review-only authority record should remain unresolved when any clock is expired or when a composed claim loses the provisionality of its weakest input.

measurement.primary: Report whether each case preserves the weakest-clock state and provenance of the independent label.
measurement.secondary: Compare a naive latest-timestamp consumer against a weakest-clock consumer on the same fixed cases.
measurement.reproduction: Run the unchanged consumers twice and require byte-identical outputs.
measurement.independence: Labels and expected outcomes must be fixed before consumer execution; consumer output cannot create or revise labels.

limits: This fixture cannot establish semantic truth or production authorization safety.
A clock value is an observation, not proof that the issuer or witness is trustworthy.
No enforcement or validator semantic change follows from this design alone.
next_step: Only materialize the fixture if a dependency-free consumer can be specified without inventing an authority oracle; otherwise retain this as a research boundary note.
